dct_description_sm:
Includes data required to create York Region Official Plan - 2010 Map 14: Highly Vulnerable Aquifers. Data such as highly vulnerable aquifers and the Oak Ridges Moraine boundary were used for this map.

The data layers do not take the place of a legal survey or other primary source documentation and may not be used to determine, certify, or verify if a parcel is a qualifying or exempt property.
